Title: General availability: Azure Data Explorer supports Conditional Access

Body.Content:
Azure Data Explorer (ADX) is now supported as an application in Azure Active Directory (AAD) Conditional Access allowing you to enforce various condition-based access policies. You can now strengthen your authentication process based on analyzing certain signals viz user’s location, device platform, device state etc. and enforce policies. This application further strengthens your security posture and achieves zero trust security. As an example, you can enforce additional authentication hurdles viz multi-factor authentication (MFA), or enforce access from recognized devices for all or certain users accessing your Azure Data Explorer clusters.

Learn more about Azure Data Explorer Conditional Access and visit the launch blog.
